import_name: Compactly supported Hodge--Deligne polynomial as an additive multiplicative invariant, and the smooth projective curve formula
author: Andrea T. Ricolfi
title: On the motive of the Quot scheme of finite quotients of a locally free sheaf
locations: Section1.1: scissor relations and product in the Grothendieck ring
Section3.2: equation(3.6), projective-space and smooth projective curve E-polynomials

used_implications: E(X)=E(X minus Z)+E(Z) for closed Z and constructible stratifications
E(X times Y)=E(X)*E(Y), hence E(A1)=u*v and E(A2)=(u*v)^2
A smooth projective curve of genus g has E=u*v-g*(u+v)+1
Removing r points gives E=u*v-g*(u+v)+1-r for a smooth connected affine curve
